description: Shrink a scanned PDF from freedailypro by turning pages into 100 dpi greyscale JPEG pictures: shading and photos are kept, colour is dropped, text on converted pages is no longer selectable. Larger than the black-and-white files but nothing is thresholded to pure black and white. A page is converted only when that makes it at least 10% smaller. Errors (nothing is returned) if the result would not be smaller than the original, or if the PDF is unreadable, password-protected or over 100 pages.

fileBase64.description: The PDF, base64 encoded (up to 20 MB, up to 100 pages)

name: pdf_compress_greyscale
